card.title: My Sponsor Inside
card.instruction: Treat one person as your sponsor inside the system. Seek their introductions and approval while resisting the identity their support assigns you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you introduce me to the committee? Just not as your promising little discovery.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As an independent professional whose work speaks for itself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It speaks more clearly after you've said my name.

mechanism: A seeks a sponsor's committee introduction while rejecting discovery status and preserving the claim of independent professionalism.
confusable: Unlike general dependence denial, the dependence is specifically on an insider's legitimating introduction and the identity it assigns.
comparison: The committee alternative needs the name spoken first; the application alternative restricts the sponsor's written account to colleague.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
